info.description: One run of the programme. Pure configuration: it has no page of its own and no URL, and is never a route.

__.note: Admin metadata for this schema. Strapi ignores this key; src/this/admin-metadata reads it and writes it into the content manager's stored configuration on every boot. Each of the six palette colours is a component of its own, so that each renders as a labelled box holding its thirteen colours; that component hides its own RGB triplets.

edit.label: Name
edit.description: The event, as it is written — "Conscious Collective 2025".

edit.label: Main event
edit.description: The event the site is currently advertising. The header and the footer follow it on every page. Marking this one demotes the one that held it.

edit.label: First day
edit.description: Shown in the header's date range and in the footer.

edit.label: Last day
edit.description: Must not fall before the first day; a save that inverts the range is refused.

edit.label: Schedule document
edit.description: The downloadable programme for this event, as a PDF.

edit.label: Archived
edit.description: Marks this event as past. Stored rather than worked out from the last day, so that an event keeps a grace period after it closes.

edit.label: Registrations are open
edit.description: Whether the site offers the registration form while this is the main event. Switched off, the Register Now button in the header and the RSVP bar at the foot of a phone's screen both disappear.

edit.label: Opens at
edit.description: The earliest time any of this event's days starts, as a clock at the venue reads it. One day may open later than another; this is the earliest of them. Shown in the footer and the floating RSVP. Leave it empty and no time is shown at all.

edit.label: Closes at
edit.description: The latest time any of this event's days ends, as a clock at the venue reads it. One day may close earlier than another; this is the latest of them. Leave it empty and the site reads "onwards" after the opening time.

edit.label: Theme
edit.description: This event's principal colour, and its buttons. It is also what a page with no role of its own is coloured by.

edit.label: Collaborator
edit.description: The colour a contributor's page is drawn in, and its buttons.
